scope: Official Gemini API billing-control review for RAG release planning; no project dashboard, key, account, payment data, prompt, or user data inspected or sent.

observed: Project-level monthly spend caps are marked experimental and can overrun by around ten minutes of billing-processing latency; long-running tasks may also exceed the project cap.
Billing-account tier caps aggregate usage across linked projects; API keys inherit project billing state and do not have independent billing settings.
Prepay reaching zero stops API keys across projects linked to that billing account, but documented processing latency may still cause overage.
Monthly auto-charge limit constrains automatic reloads; manually initiated one-time purchases do not count against that limit.

official_sources.observed: Billing state of the project used for Gemini API access determines whether the service is treated as Paid Service; the actual TamsoodBase project state was not inspected.

change.added: Owner-only billing verification checklist and explicit warning that Gemini spend controls are not a hard zero-overrun guarantee.

validation.git_diff_check: passed; CRLF normalization warnings only, no whitespace errors

limitations: Official docs establish provider behavior but do not establish this project's selected billing mode, cap, payment settings, account linkage, or actual spend.
No claim is made that current Gemini spend is bounded to a user-approved amount.
